name: Body Imagery Tiles (high-definition mosaics)
description: A body's high-definition global imagery as the console's tile pyramid. Sources: Mars THEMIS Day IR 100 m v12 (NAIF 499, the unit default) and the small bodies of src/sources_small.hpp, named by the unit's naif; gray or RGB (planes read as one range each, rows_0..rows_2) (NASA/JPL/ASU, public domain; BigTIFF, 8-bit, one row per strip, planetocentric on the MOLA sphere). tiles_plan names the whole-row byte range of the mosaic one level-9 tile row needs (If-Match on its ETag); tiles_direct area-averages those rows in WASM into 256 px baseline JPEG tiles on the body's two-root geographic scheme (GEOGRAPHIC_TWO_ROOT_BODY, rows from the south), one $DTT record per tile (PAYLOAD_FORMAT CUSTOM, MEDIA_TYPE image/jpeg); tiles_reduce builds a coarser level's row from the two child rows already made (JPEG decode, 2x2 mean of the measured pixels, JPEG), root levels 0-2 from level 3. Files are size-prefixed $DTT streams of 16 tiles of one row, in the layout the engine's imageryFromTileFiles reads: imagery/<NAIF id>/root.dtts (levels 0-2) and imagery/<NAIF id>/<L>/<X16>_<Y>.dtts (X16 = x >> 4, Y from the south). Level 9 (81.4 m/px) is the deepest. TYPED CONTRACTS 1.0: FlatBuffers only between modules; node config through plugin.getConfig. tiles_window encodes bounded Moon LO+UVVIS and USGS CTX grayscale windows above protected base levels.

sequentialJustification.detail: Each method is a single-pass transform over the frames it is handed: a plan, a tile row from source rows, or a parent row from child files. No shared mutable state, no workers.
